title: AutoClick
description: A microservices app for an auto service and sales center, tracking inventory, technicians, and service appointments across a Django/React stack, containerized with Docker.

title: FieldFix
description: A service-request tracking app for transit and facility operations, built as an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages web app with a parallel Microsoft Power Platform (Dataverse + Power Automate) implementation.

title: Two-Layer NN — CIFAR-10 Classifier (Demo)
description: A from-scratch two-layer neural network (manual forward/backward pass, no autograd) trained on CIFAR-10, wrapped in a Gradio app where you upload an image and get a 10-class prediction.

title: RouteWatch
description: A Django transit operations dashboard that pulls live NYC Open Data crash feeds to monitor road conditions and service risks across routes, built as an interview-friendly monolithic app.
